description: Plaatselijke hoofdstukken en bestaande beelden gelezen en bekeken; nieuwe resultaten gecontroleerd op inhoud, anatomie en leesbaarheid.

images.alt: Lesbeeld: een logeerplek klaarmaken — Filemon 1:22; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Philemon 1:22 asks Philemon to prepare a guest room for Paul, who hopes to be restored through their prayers. Illustrative enactment of this request, not Paul already arriving: a first-century household room with a plain wooden sleeping couch and a wool blanket, an adult householder spreading the blanket neatly with two hands and another person setting a small water jug on a low table. Warm daylight, modest domestic setting, no rich hotel, readable writing or returning apostle at the door. Two adults fully clothed, coherent natural anatomy.
